ja401:1.1: Dasaṇṇakaṃ tikhiṇadhāraṃ asiṃ sampanna pāyinaṃ parisāyaṃ puriso gilati kiṃ dukkarataraṃ tato, yad aññaṃ dukkaraṃ ṭhānaṃ tam me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja401:2.1: Gileyya puriso lobhā asiṃ sampanna pāyinaṃ, yo ca vajjā dadāmīti taṃ dukkarataram tato, sabb' aññaṃ sukaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi Māgadhā 'ti.
ja401:3.1: Vyākāsi Āyuro pañhaṃ atthadhammassa kovido, Pukkusaṃ dāni pucchāmi: kiṃ dukkarataraṃ tato, yad aññaṃ dukkaraṃ ṭhānaṃ tam me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja401:4.1: Na vācam upajīvanti aphalaṃ giram udīritaṃ, yo ca datvā avākayirā taṃ dukkarataraṃ tato, sabb' aññaṃ sukaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi Māgadhā 'ti.
ja401:5.1: Vyākāsi Pukkuso pañhaṃ atthadhammassa kovido, Senakaṃ dāni pucchāmi: kiṃ dukkarataraṃ tato, yad aññaṃ dukkaraṃ ṭhānam tam me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja401:6.1: Dadeyya puriso dānaṃ appaṃ vā yadivā bahuṃ, yo ca datvā nānutape taṃ dukkarataraṃ tato, sabb' aññam sukaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi Māgadhā 'ti.
ja401:7.1: Vyākāsi Āyuro pañhaṃ atha Pukkusa-poriso, sabbe pañhe atihoti yathā bhāsati Senako ti.
